```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  function updateLogoFolder() {
    const darkMode =
      document.documentElement.classList.contains("quarto-dark") ||
      document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark") ||
      document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-bs-theme") === "dark" ||
      document.body.getAttribute("data-bs-theme") === "dark";

    const folder = darkMode ? "dark" : "light";

    document
      .querySelectorAll('img[src*="logos/light/"], img[src*="logos/dark/"]')
      .forEach(function (img) {
        img.setAttribute(
          "src",
          img.getAttribute("src").replace(
            /logos\/(light|dark)\//,
            "logos/" + folder + "/"
          )
        );
      });
  }

  updateLogoFolder();

  const observer = new MutationObserver(updateLogoFolder);

  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ["class", "data-bs-theme"]
  });

  observer.observe(document.body, {
    attributes: true,
    childList: true,
    subtree: true,
    attributeFilter: ["class", "data-bs-theme"]
  });
});
</script>
```

```{=html}
<!--
  The following <div> section is a bugfix.

  during rendering and may not copy the files into the final website output.
  This hidden block makes the dark helper-package logos visible to Quarto's
  resource handling, so they are included in the rendered site.
-->
```
